clips.prompt:
15-second cinematic sequence, vertical 9:16, realistic, 35mm film look, film grain, cold blue tones.
Shot 1 (0-4s): Aerial drone shot at dusk slowly gliding over a foggy pine forest toward an isolated modern-rustic two-story wooden cabin; a black minivan drives away down the forest road.
Shot 2 (4-8s): Six attractive, stylish young Georgian people with lean bodies and designer backpacks walk up to the cabin and look at it uneasily.
Throughout shots 1-2: A deep, calm, mysterious male narrator voice-over (not on screen) says slowly and clearly in Georgian: "ექვს უცნობ ადამიანს ორმოცდაათი ათასი ლარი შესთავაზეს. პირობა ერთი იყო: შვიდი დღე ამ სახლში, ტელეფონების გარეშე."
Shot 3 (8-11s): Night, inside a stylish rustic living room with warm lamps, the six sit on sofas. A black speaker on the wall crackles, and a calm, deep, slightly distorted male voice from the speaker says in Georgian: "კეთილი იყოს თქვენი მობრძანება."
Shot 4 (11-15s): The speaker voice continues in Georgian: "თქვენ შორის ერთი ჩვენთვის მუშაობს." Quick cuts across the six shocked faces as they slowly look at each other with suspicion. The last cut lands on a handsome lean young Georgian man with styled dark wavy hair and stubble in a black leather jacket, staring at a beautiful young woman with long light-brown waves and gold hoops.
Characters are fashionable and good-looking. Natural lip movement. Ambient: wind, static crackle. No subtitles, no text on screen.
